Desc.SourceString: 委托所说的异象，看来就在这附近。
Desc.LocalizedString: The anomaly mentioned in the commission seems to be nearby.

Desc.SourceString: 紊乱的气息越来越强烈了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The chaotic aura is getting stronger.

Desc.SourceString: 这个地方……还是小心为妙。
Desc.LocalizedString: I might want to tread very carefully here…

Desc.SourceString: 被异象占据的废弃校园……
Desc.LocalizedString: An abandoned campus occupied by anomalies…

Desc.SourceString: 那扇红门可能就是关键。
Desc.LocalizedString: That red door might be the key.

Desc.SourceString: 「校园」观光该结束了。
Desc.LocalizedString: About time this "campus" tour came to an end.

Desc.SourceString: 新的空间？
Desc.LocalizedString: A new space?

Desc.SourceString: （呜哇，对、对不起！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Eep! S-Sorry!)

Desc.SourceString: （住手！我认输了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Stop! I surrender…)

Desc.SourceString: （可恶，已经没力气再分身了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Damn it, I don't have the energy to split myself anymore…)

Desc.SourceString: （呜哇……点，点到为止！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Eep…! T-Take it easy!)

Desc.SourceString: 漫画书里全是落叶，是什么恶作剧吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: The manga's stuffed with leaves. Is this someone's idea of a prank?

Desc.SourceString: 好多奇怪的爪印，把骑士的名字都盖住了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Weird paw prints are obscuring the knights' names.

Desc.SourceString: 武侠小说，忍者漫画，勇士大战恶龙，甚至还有一本猎人指南？好丰富的阅读量。
Desc.LocalizedString: Martial arts novels, ninja manga, tales of warriors battling dragons, and even a hunter's guide? Quite the eclectic reading list.

Desc.SourceString: （好眼力！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Sharp eye!)

Desc.SourceString: <!>这些树叶有歧骸的气息……那家伙应该就在附近。
Desc.LocalizedString: These leaves have the scent of a monstrous creature... that guy must be nearby.

Desc.SourceString: <!>食物上有小型动物的牙印，还有……歧骸的气息。
Desc.LocalizedString: The food had the teeth marks of small animals, and... the scent of a monstrous creature.

Desc.SourceString: 主角：是少女漫呢……该说真不愧是《月刊罗曼史》吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a shoujo manga… that's Monthly Romance for you…

Desc.SourceString: （你的光辉还需打磨，更多地燃烧自己之后再来吧！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Your brilliance still needs refining; come back once you've burned even brighter!)

Desc.SourceString: （贫弱贫弱！连站稳都做不到的话就不用再比了！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Weak and frail! If you can't even stand firm, there's no need to compete further!)

Desc.SourceString: 连续的爆炸，那团<blue>诡异的时空波动</>，似乎与<blue>影片的奇点</>有着某种不可名状的联系……
Desc.LocalizedString: Explosions, strange <blue>time-space fluctuations</>… seem to be somewhat connected with the <blue>Nexus in the film</>…

Desc.SourceString: 再 <blue>回去调查下放映机</>吧，是时候「落幕」了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's <blue>check the projector</> again. It's time for the finale.

Desc.SourceString: 空间向前延展，幽暗的走廊逐渐拉长，周围的环境透着一股沉寂的老旧气息。
Desc.LocalizedString: Space stretched forward as the dim corridor grew longer, exuding an air of desolate antiquity.

Desc.SourceString: 放映机让破旧的楼梯「还原」了，它好像在「引导」着我……去楼上看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: The projector "restored" the dilapidated staircase. It seems to be guiding me… I should head upstairs to investigate.

Desc.SourceString: 放映机启动后似乎没有反应……等等，如果「开启」会改变环境，那么「关闭」是否会有同样的效果呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: The projector won't respond after starting up… Wait, if turning it "on" changes the environment, perhaps turning it "off" have a similar effect?

Desc.SourceString: 安静的房间里传来了一阵压抑沉重的声音，这声音并非来自楼下，而是「楼上」的深处……
Desc.LocalizedString: A muffled, heavy sound echoed through the quiet room—not from downstairs, but from deep within the upper floor…

Desc.SourceString: 皱巴巴的小纸条
Desc.LocalizedString: Crumpled Note

Desc.SourceString: ABDCB
Desc.LocalizedString: ABDCB

Desc.LocalizedString: PUT THE KEYS BACK ONTO THE POT NEXT TIME YOU USE IT!!!

You, said, you, would, stay, with, us, stay. Stay. Stay. Stay. Stay. Stay stay stay stay stay no leaving is not allowed don't leave can't leave don't leave can't leave don't leave

Desc.SourceString: 我们说好要一起玩的吧？一二三、木头人！我们是木头人噢！放学后来玩一二三、木头人吧？我们是你的木头人朋友噢！我们是你的朋友噢！我们是最好的玩伴噢！玩伴就要永远一起玩吧？一起玩吧？一起玩一起玩一起玩一起玩一起玩
Desc.LocalizedString: We are going to play together! Green light… red light! Come on! Red light… green light! We are your friends here, we are the bestest buddies! Red light green light red light green light let's play let's play let's play let's play let's play.

Desc.SourceString: 一个书架……？不对，它散发着阴冷的气息。
Desc.LocalizedString: A bookshelf…? No, there's something off about it—it feels cold and sinister.

Desc.SourceString:
教职工室钥匙神秘失窃！凶手尚未自首！走廊上鬼鬼祟祟的家伙都要小心了！别让我抓到是谁偷走了钥匙！
——你们愤怒的学生会长
Desc.LocalizedString:
The staff room key has mysteriously vanished! The culprit has yet to confess! All you sneaky folks in the hallway better watch out! Don't let me catch whoever snatched the key!
- Your Angry Student Council President

Desc.SourceString: 你要走了吗？不要走不准走不许走没法走
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you leaving? Don't leave can't leave don't leave can't leave-

Desc.SourceString: 锁上的宝箱，里面有什么好东西吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: A locked treasure chest—what goodies could be inside?

Desc.SourceString: 还以为是什么危险事件……
Desc.LocalizedString: I thought it was something dangerous…

Desc.SourceString: 到头来只是个乌龙啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: So it's just a misunderstanding after all.

Desc.SourceString: （草丛里有奇怪的动静，过去看看吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There's something strange rustling in the bushes. I should go check it out.)

Desc.SourceString: 呜……呜呜……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… sniff sniff…

Desc.SourceString: （车箱里好像有什么声音，听上去不像是嘭嘭朵……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (There is a sound coming from the trunk, but it doesn't sound like a Boom Boom Cloud…)

Desc.SourceString: 这是哪里……好黑……呜呜……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where am I… It's so dark… Sob…

Desc.SourceString: 好想回家……谁来救救我……
Desc.LocalizedString: I just want to go home… Someone, please save me…

Desc.SourceString: （也不像是人类……莫非是歧骸？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It doesn't look human either… Could it be an oddity?)

Desc.SourceString: （订单中没有提及此事，或许该联系异象管理局调查一下。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This wasn't mentioned in the order. Maybe I should contact the BAC.)

Desc.SourceString: 这个异象把它周围的环境变成了白色……
Desc.LocalizedString: This anomaly has turned the environment around it white…

Desc.SourceString: 这些纸上画的是……大厦设计图？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's drawn on these papers is… building blueprints?

Desc.SourceString: 这座大厦……和纸上画的一模一样，看来这是它的异象空间。
Desc.LocalizedString: This building… looks exactly like what's drawn on the paper. It seems this is its Anomalous Realm.

Desc.SourceString: 一张漂浮的图纸……似乎是刚才那个异象的一部分。
Desc.LocalizedString: A floating blueprint… It seems to be part of that anomaly from earlier.

Desc.SourceString: 哪里来的这么多小广告……
Desc.LocalizedString: Where did all these flyers come from…

Desc.SourceString: 为什么所有的广告都要贴在这一面墙上？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why are all these ads plastered on this one wall?

Desc.SourceString: 贴在这么高的地方，到底谁能看得见……
Desc.LocalizedString: Who would even see ads posted this high up…

Desc.SourceString: 不知是谁丢在这里的日记，内页字迹娟秀工整，夹杂着随手画的涂鸦和小表情。
Desc.LocalizedString: Someone's diary left here. The pages are filled with neat, elegant handwriting mixed with casual doodles and little emoticons.

Desc.SourceString: 找到了，这就是她丢失的日记吧。好厚啊……少女有这么多心事要记录吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Found it! This must be her lost diary. Wow, it's so thick… Do girls really have this many thoughts to write down?

Desc.SourceString: 一本眼熟的日记，怎么又出现在了这里。这下就算把眼睛滴成游泳池，也保不住她那些糗事了。
Desc.LocalizedString: A familiar diary… how did it end up here again? Even if she cried an ocean of tears, it wouldn't save her from the embarrassment of all those secrets being out there.

Desc.SourceString: 有点奇怪的收音机，不知道是谁落在了这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: A rather strange radio. I wonder who left it here.

Desc.SourceString: 找到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Found it.

Desc.SourceString: 试图封上盒子时，「增殖的C」忽然撞了过来！<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>噔噔！噔噔噔噔噔噔噔噔！噔噔噔噔！<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>
Desc.LocalizedString: Just as I was trying to close the box, Proliferative C suddenly came charging at me! <TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>Da-da! Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da! Da-da-da-da!<TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>

Desc.SourceString: （空间发生了变化，像是投影在同一个平面一样……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The space has changed, like everything's been projected onto the same plane…)

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼……理解得很快嘛，但这不过是我伟大设计的一角！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heh heh… You catch on quick, but that's just a tiny piece of my grand design!

Desc.SourceString: 异象的躁动似乎渐渐平息了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The anomaly's restless energy seems to be gradually settling down.

Desc.SourceString: 空间似乎在围绕我旋转……尝试改变视角的话，应该能找到抵达楼顶的路……
Desc.LocalizedString: The space seems to be rotating around me… If I try changing my view, I should be able to find a path to the rooftop…

Desc.SourceString: ……不管怎么说，总算是完成了收容。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Well, at least I managed to contain it.

Desc.SourceString: （仓库重地！闲人免进！需要许可！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Restricted Warehouse Area! No Unauthorized Entry! Permit Required!)

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈，今天讲什么故事呀？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mom, what story are you going to tell today?

Desc.SourceString: 换一个没听过的新故事好不好？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can't you tell me a new story?

Desc.SourceString: 唉，要是有一本新的故事书就好了，我的朋友们最近都在看《狐狸的秋千》。
Desc.LocalizedString: If only we had a new storybook. My friends have all been reading "The Fox and the Swing."

Desc.SourceString: 要是有一本新的故事书就好了，是不是呀，妈妈？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mom, we just need a new storybook, don't we?

Desc.SourceString: 不要不要不要！不要去上学！
Desc.LocalizedString: No, no, no! I don't want to go to school!

Desc.SourceString: 真的会有礼物吗？可以现在就给我吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: A gift? Can I have it right now?

Desc.SourceString: 我一定会乖乖听课的！拜托拜托……
Desc.LocalizedString: I promise I'll be good and listen in class! Please…

Desc.SourceString: 面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶……要放多少糖呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Flour, eggs, milk… how much sugar should I add?

Desc.SourceString: 呜……柠檬好酸，真的要放进去吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… lemons are so sour, do I really have to use them?

Desc.SourceString: 蛋糕原来这么难做……不行不行，我一定要做出来送给妈妈当生日礼物！
Desc.LocalizedString: Baking a cake is so hard! I can' give up… I'm going to make a cake for my Mom's birthday!

Desc.SourceString: 要是能知道妈妈做蛋糕的配方就好了……
Desc.LocalizedString: If I had Mom's recipe…

Desc.SourceString: 我想在这里画一个秋千可以吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Can I paint a swing here?

Desc.SourceString: 太棒啦！跟公园里一样的秋千！
Desc.LocalizedString: Great! It's just like the swing in the park!

Desc.SourceString: 我还想要一些漂亮的花，房子画成什么颜色的呢……想不出来了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I also want pretty flowers, but what color should the house be? I can't think of any…

Desc.SourceString: 院子……是什么样子的呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: The yard… what should it look like…?

Desc.SourceString: 妈妈我好喜欢这个故事，明天再讲一遍好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mom, I really love this story! Can you tell it again tomorrow?

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢妈妈，妈妈真好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, Mom. You're the best!

Desc.SourceString: 哇！谢谢妈妈！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow! Thank you, Mom!

Desc.SourceString: 对不起妈妈……今天早上我闹脾气了，以后就算没有礼物我也会乖乖上学的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Mom… I threw a tantrum this morning. I'll go to school like a good kid even if there are no gifts.

Desc.SourceString: 好哦好哦，我们拉钩。
Desc.LocalizedString: Okay, okay, pinky promise!

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，这可是我自己做的哦！妈妈你快尝尝！绝对跟你做的一模一样！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, I made this all by myself! Mom, give it a try! It definitely tastes the same as yours!

Desc.SourceString: 好甜QAQ
Desc.LocalizedString: So sweet…!

Desc.SourceString: 好！下次我们一起做蛋糕。
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course! Let's bake a cake together next time.

Desc.SourceString: 当当当！完成啦！妈妈快看快看！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ta-da! All done! Mom, look, look!

Desc.SourceString: 设计……师？哇，那我长大后要成为最厉害的设计师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Architect…? Woah, when I grow up, I want to become the best architect! Ever!

Desc.SourceString: 等秋千做好了，我们一起玩哦！拉钩……
Desc.LocalizedString: Once the swing is ready, we'll play together! Pinky promise…

Desc.SourceString: 那是我们最喜欢的故事，小狐狸和妈妈一起在桔梗花田里荡秋千。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was our favorite story, about the little fox and mom swinging together in the bellflower field.

Desc.SourceString: 一遍又一遍，直到梦里都开满蓝色的桔梗花。
Desc.LocalizedString: Over and over again, until even our dreams bloomed with blue bellflowers.

Desc.SourceString: 我多想再为你讲一次这个故事。
Desc.LocalizedString: How I wish I could tell you this story one more time.

Desc.SourceString: 我们都遵守了约定，就算没有礼物也会乖乖上学。
Desc.LocalizedString: We all kept our promise, going to school like a good kid even without receiving any gifts.

Desc.SourceString: 就算没有我……也一样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even without me… it's all the same.

Desc.SourceString: 那是我吃过最甜的蛋糕，甜到我们把家里的水都喝光了。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was the sweetest cake I ever had. It's so sweet, we drank all the water in the house.

Desc.SourceString: 甜到在我最后的那段时间里，依旧会想起那个味道。
Desc.LocalizedString: So sweet, that even in my final days, I still remembered the taste.

Desc.SourceString: 希望……小帕蒂以后也能继续开心地吃蛋糕。
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope… my dear Patty can have her cakes as delicious as ever…

Desc.SourceString: 对不起……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry…

Desc.SourceString: 对不起，帕蒂……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Patty…

Desc.SourceString: 没有能看着你成为最厉害的设计师。
Desc.LocalizedString: I wasn't able to see you become the most amazing architect.

Desc.SourceString: 需完成任务：幽灵列车的好乘客指南
Desc.LocalizedString: Prerequisite: Norms on the Anomaly Express

Desc.SourceString: 虽然是个草率的都市传说，主题倒是很劝人向善呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Pretty uplifting for a run-of-the-mill urban legend.

Desc.SourceString: 是不是都无所谓吧……如果是的话会怎样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Does it really matter either way… What would happen if we were?

Desc.SourceString: 那如果不是呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What if we're not?

Desc.SourceString: 那不就是无所谓嘛。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then it doesn't really matter either way.

Desc.SourceString: 要不改名白藏大三角吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Yeah. Or maybe we should call it the Baicang Great Triangle.

Desc.SourceString: 因为肯定是你瞎编的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Given your talent of making that up on the spot.

Desc.SourceString: <！>似乎今天已经祈祷过了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: <！>Wait, haven't you already said your prayers for today?!

Desc.SourceString: <！>似乎来太早了，晚上再来吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: <！>Looks like you're a bit early. Come back tonight!

Desc.SourceString: （或许，应该从背后靠近它试试）
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe I should try approaching it from behind.

Desc.SourceString: 大概是安魂曲在里面睡熟了吧……还是不要打扰她了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa's probably fast asleep… I should leave her be.

Desc.SourceString: 话先说在前面，我可不是特意来帮你的！只是这家伙也正好挡了我的路！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me make this clear, I'm not here to help! This one was just in my way too!

Desc.SourceString: 嗨！需要帮忙吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Need any help?

Desc.SourceString: 嚯，你怎么被这种家伙缠上了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Whoa, how did you get tangled up with someone like this?

Desc.SourceString: 下次要是还有这种事，喊我来就行。
Desc.LocalizedString: Just call me if this happens again.

Desc.SourceString: 打得真痛快！
Desc.LocalizedString: That felt great!

Desc.SourceString: 我走啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm outta here!

Desc.SourceString: 别在这倒下啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you fall down here!

Desc.SourceString: 喂，振作点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, snap out of it!

Desc.SourceString: 还没结束呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's not over!

Desc.SourceString: 不要害怕，柯林斯一代目前来救场！我会保护好你的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Fear not, for the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis is here to save the day!

Desc.SourceString: 放心把后背交给我吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll watch your back!

Desc.SourceString: 天空一声巨响，老大闪亮登场！
Desc.LocalizedString: Boom, swoosh, pow! It's the Ichi-daime!

Desc.SourceString: 呼，解决了！柯林斯家族，今天也在泯除邪恶！
Desc.LocalizedString: All done! The Coluccis have nullified evil for another day!

Desc.SourceString: 赢啦，合作愉快！
Desc.LocalizedString: We won! Happy working with you!

Desc.SourceString: 不用道谢，多多宣传柯林斯的威名就行了！
Desc.LocalizedString: No need to thank me, just spread the word about the Coluccis!

Desc.SourceString: 有本老大罩着你呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Ichi-daime got you covered!

Desc.SourceString: 别放弃啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't give up!

Desc.SourceString: 让这家伙看看咱们的厉害！
Desc.LocalizedString: Show them what we're made of!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，遇到麻烦了吗？明白了，我会……尽力帮忙的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you need help? Got it. I'll… I'll do my best!

Desc.SourceString: 我会尽力支援……！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll support you as much as I can…!

Desc.SourceString: 我也来帮忙……
Desc.LocalizedString: Let me help too…

Desc.SourceString: 呼……圆满解决。辛苦了，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew… Problem solved. Thank you, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 大家都没事就好……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm glad everyone's okay…

Desc.SourceString: 结束了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's over…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，再坚持一下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, hang in there!

Desc.SourceString: 还有希望……！
Desc.LocalizedString: There's still hope…!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你还好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you okay?

Desc.SourceString: 可可，竟然在进行这么危险的作战……我也要来帮忙！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, this fight is dangerous… I have to help!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，我来帮忙了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, I'm here to help!

Desc.SourceString: 来吧，我们一起大干一场~
Desc.LocalizedString: Together, our fight will be legendary!

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷队员，圆满完成任务！得找个地方好好睡一觉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint, mission complete! Now I need to get some good sleep.

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，我的表现还不错吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, I did pretty well, didn't I?

Desc.SourceString: 看来这家伙已经被解决了，那我走了哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like this one's been taken care of. I'm heading out!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，不要输——
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, don't give up!

Desc.SourceString: 我来支援了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm here to help!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，振作起来——
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, pull yourself together!

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲，起床，来这里……看见怪物，不喜欢。要帮忙消灭。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, woke up, came here… see monster, don't like. Help take care…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，好像很辛苦……安魂曲，来帮忙。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, hard time… Lacrimosa, help.

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲，来帮鉴定师的忙……
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, help Appraiser…

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲，下班……不对，安魂曲刚才……没在上班？
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, off work… But Lacrimosa… had no shift?

Desc.SourceString: 下次见，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Later, appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 赢了……安魂曲，困了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Won… Lacrimosa, sleepy.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，不要睡着了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, don't sleep.

Desc.SourceString: 番茄酱，分你一点……
Desc.LocalizedString: Tomato Jelly, for you…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师……振作，加油。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser… cheer up, keep going.

Desc.SourceString: 鄙人相信鉴定师定能战胜这敌人。不过多一份助力，大约能轻松些。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I believe you can win. But it would be easier if you had more help.

Desc.SourceString: 或许有我能帮得上忙的地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps I can be of assistance.

Desc.SourceString: 单打独斗未免辛苦，我来帮忙。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's dangerous to fight alone. Let me help!

Desc.SourceString: 辛苦了。善后工作，交给我就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice work. Leave the rest to me.

Desc.SourceString: 意料之内的胜利。
Desc.LocalizedString: An expected victory.

Desc.SourceString: 那么，我就先回伊波恩了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Well then, I shall return to Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: 请您放心前行。
Desc.LocalizedString: You can proceed with confidence.

Desc.SourceString: 防护铺设完成。
Desc.LocalizedString: Defense, in place.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，坚持住。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, hang in there.

Desc.SourceString: 振作一点，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Pull yourself together, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 此次介入仅为我的个人行动，与E.T.D无关。只是来帮朋友处理麻烦。
Desc.LocalizedString: This intervention has nothing to do with ETD. I acted alone. Just helping a friend.

Desc.SourceString: 需要帮助吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Need a hand?

Desc.SourceString: 维护秩序是我的职责所在。
Desc.LocalizedString: My duty is to maintain order.

Desc.SourceString: 处理完毕。四队还有其他工作，我先告辞了。
Desc.LocalizedString: All clear. Squad 4 has other tasks to attend to. I'll take my leave.

Desc.SourceString: 合作愉快。
Desc.LocalizedString: Pleasure working with you.

Desc.SourceString: 下次见。
Desc.LocalizedString: Until next time.

Desc.SourceString: 最佳进攻时机。
Desc.LocalizedString: Time to strike.

Desc.SourceString: 火力支援就绪。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ready to support.

Desc.SourceString: 可以进行压制。
Desc.LocalizedString: Prepared to suppress.

Desc.SourceString: 乖孩子，需要帮忙吗？不要独自面对这份痛苦……也分享给我一些吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Cutie, need help? Don't face that pain alone… you can share it with me.

Desc.SourceString: 新猎物……看起来真不赖~
Desc.LocalizedString: New prey… That's exciting.

Desc.SourceString: 有新的消遣了呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Something new to play with.

Desc.SourceString: 这就结束了吗？真是不耐用啊~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's over already? So weak.

Desc.SourceString: 那么，我们下次再见咯~
Desc.LocalizedString: Until next time!

Desc.SourceString: 真是尽兴呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was fun.

Desc.SourceString: 再激烈一点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Harder!

Desc.SourceString: 把痛楚，分给这家伙吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Share the pain with this one!

Desc.SourceString: 去践踏，去摧残……
Desc.LocalizedString: Trample and dominate!

Desc.SourceString: 业务范围外的战斗……帮你一把也无妨。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is not my job description… but I don't mind lending you a hand.

Desc.SourceString: 我会协助你战斗。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll assist you in battle.

Desc.SourceString: 看来你陷入了麻烦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Looks like you're in trouble.

Desc.SourceString: 这是我个人立场的帮助，并非委托，因此不收取委托费用。
Desc.LocalizedString: I won't charge you fees. I'm helping you out of my own volition.

Desc.SourceString: 告辞。
Desc.LocalizedString: I shall take my leave.

Desc.SourceString: 任务完成。
Desc.LocalizedString: Quest complete.

Desc.SourceString: 情况不容乐观。
Desc.LocalizedString: Things aren't looking great.

Desc.SourceString: 别放弃。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't give up.

Desc.SourceString: 支援已就位。
Desc.LocalizedString: Support in position.

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅·克雷斯维尔，回应你的呼唤！这样的台词果然很帅啊！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel Cresswell, answering your call…! That was a great line!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，让我们并肩作战吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, let's fight side by side!

Desc.SourceString: 斯特利王牌快递员驾到！
Desc.LocalizedString: Sterry's ace delivery girl has arrived!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么样，哈尼娅有帮上忙吧？这下我们的羁绊又加深啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: I did my part! Our bond is growing stronger!

Desc.SourceString: 呜哇，派件要超时了，我得赶紧走了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh no, running late… gotta do my next delivery!

Desc.SourceString: 走啦，以后也可以再召唤我帮忙！
Desc.LocalizedString: Off I go! You can always call me for help!

Desc.SourceString: 这就是「友情」的力量！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is the power of friendship!

Desc.SourceString: 我们的使命还没有完成……还不能倒下！
Desc.LocalizedString: Our mission isn't over yet… We can't fall down here!

Desc.SourceString: 哈尼娅正在为你充电！
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel, charging you up!

Desc.SourceString: 嗨嗨嗨，要帮忙吗？就算你说不需要，我也已经在这里了哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey there, need a hand? Even if you don't, I'm already here!

Desc.SourceString: 找了半天，原来你在这儿啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: So this is where you were. I looked everywhere!

Desc.SourceString: 好！来活动活动筋骨吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Okay! Time for some exercise!

Desc.SourceString: 请付我加班费——开玩笑的啦，能帮到你就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: You better pay me overtime… Just kidding! I'm happy to help.

Desc.SourceString: 此地不宜久留，溜了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This place isn't safe. I'm out!

Desc.SourceString: 呼~收工收工。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew… that's a wrap!

Desc.SourceString: 速战速决吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's finish this quickly.

Desc.SourceString: 好，使出全力吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright, let's do our best!

Desc.SourceString: 下手、还可以、再重一点的哦——！
Desc.LocalizedString: Nice hit… but you can do better than that!

Desc.SourceString: 来了来了，怎么这么大阵仗？可不能让我们家招财宝吃了亏！
Desc.LocalizedString: What's with all the commotion? I won't let anyone mess with our Precious!

Desc.SourceString: 就是你这家伙，在欺负我们招财宝？
Desc.LocalizedString: So you're the one bullying our Precious?

Desc.SourceString: 这儿可真是不太平啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: This place isn't very safe.

Desc.SourceString: 我先回去睡觉了啊。吵吵嚷嚷的，震得我脑壳疼……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm going back to sleep. All this noise is giving me a headache…

Desc.SourceString: 要跟我一起回伊波恩吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Wanna go back to Eibon with me?

Desc.SourceString: 比想象中麻烦一些……困了。
Desc.LocalizedString: More trouble than I expected… (yawns).

Desc.SourceString: 招财宝！振作一点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Precious! Pull yourself together!

Desc.SourceString: 再等等……就快赢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hold on a bit… we're almost there.

Desc.SourceString: 还好吗？能坚持吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You okay? Can you still fight?

Desc.SourceString: 是委托吗？我来帮忙。
Desc.LocalizedString: A commission? I'll help.

Desc.SourceString: 别担心，我在。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I'm here.

Desc.SourceString: 我来了，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: I've arrived, Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 解决了。我就先回伊波恩了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's done. I'll return to Eibon.

Desc.SourceString: 结束了，好好休息。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's over. Get some rest.

Desc.SourceString: 我会保护你。
Desc.LocalizedString: I shall protect you.

Desc.SourceString: 注意敌人动向。
Desc.LocalizedString: Watch enemy movements.

Desc.SourceString: 不能让你受伤……
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't let you get hurt…

Desc.SourceString: 需要帮忙吗？这次出手，我可以不收费哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Need some help? I'll do it pro bono this time!

Desc.SourceString: 原来你在这儿啊……有趣。
Desc.LocalizedString: So you're here… interesting.

Desc.SourceString: 别来无恙啊，鉴定师~
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, how have you been?

Desc.SourceString: 好啦，问题解决。我来帮你这件事，可别告诉你们店长哟？
Desc.LocalizedString: Problem solved. Don't tell Hotori I helped, okay?

Desc.SourceString: 「人情债」可是最难还的~
Desc.LocalizedString: Favors are the hardest debts to repay!

Desc.SourceString: 累了吧，回去记得好好休息哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: You must be tired. Get some good rest when you can!

Desc.SourceString: 你要是倒在这儿，我可不好交差啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'll have a lot of paperwork to do if you collapse here…

Desc.SourceString: 驱散阴霾……
Desc.LocalizedString: Dispelling darkness…

Desc.SourceString: 别在这儿睡下啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't fall asleep here!

Desc.SourceString: 没有反应……时间太早了吗？等到晚上再来看看吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: No response… Is it too early? I'll come back and check again tonight.

Desc.SourceString: 感觉不久之前才来过？再耐心等待一段时间吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Feels like I was just here not too long ago… I should wait a little longer before trying again.

Desc.SourceString: 一份关于特殊患者的转诊记录：「患者出现明显焦虑情绪及异常行为，其坚持用绷带自行紧缚患处，拒绝摘下，并对光、声刺激极其敏感……」
Desc.LocalizedString: A transfer record for a special patient: "The patient exhibited significant anxiety and abnormal behavior, insisting on tightly binding the affected areas with bandages and refusing to remove them. Patient also shows extreme sensitivity to visual and auditory stimuli."

Desc.SourceString: 一份药房内的监听文件：「V的忠诚度有待进一步观察，且疑似已对监视有所察觉，需更换更隐蔽的方式。
Desc.LocalizedString: A surveillance file from the pharmacy: "V's loyalty requires further observation. Subject may have become aware of surveillance. Recommend switching to more covert methods."

Desc.SourceString: 一份诊室内的通讯记录：「既然病人是你接手，这次就由你代我们科室出面了，V。」
Desc.LocalizedString: A communication record from the examination room: "Since you're handling the patient, you'll represent our department this time, V."

Desc.SourceString: 一份手术室的事故记录：「发生严重事故，患者术中苏醒，并███；推测原因为██试图摘取捆缚患者肢体的绷带。」
Desc.LocalizedString: An incident report from the operating room: "Serious incident occurred. Patient regained consciousness during surgery and ███. Suspected cause: ██ attempted to remove bandages binding the patient's limbs."

Desc.SourceString: 一封已寄出的邮件，落款写着N：「……我不知道V在手术室里经历了什么，我只庆幸他还能派上用场，不然的话，恐怕得轮到我去接手这一群可怕的患者了。」
Desc.LocalizedString: A sent email, signed by N: "…I don't know what V went through in there, I'm just relieved he can still be of use. Otherwise, I'd be the one who has to take over dealing with these terrifying patients…"

Desc.SourceString: 一封告密信：「……事态紧急，恳请您立即介入调查，并对V采取隔离与控制措施。」
Desc.LocalizedString: An anonymous tip-off letter: "…This is an emergency. I implore you to intervene immediately and implement isolation and containment measures for V!"

Desc.SourceString: 一份监控，记录摄像头捕捉到了一个深夜的可疑人员：「已确认为实验员V，将就此事进行讯问。」
Desc.LocalizedString: A surveillance log. The camera captured a suspicious individual late at night: "Confirmed to be Researcher V. An interrogation will be conducted regarding this matter."

Desc.SourceString: 一份工作日志，记录了储水间管理员的抱怨和得到的回复：「能不能别让203病房那个绑绷带的疯子靠近水阀？我们为他花了好多维修费了！」
Desc.LocalizedString: A work log documenting a complaint from the water storage room manager and the response received: "Could someone please keep an eye on that bandaged lunatic in Room 203 and stop him from getting near the water valves? He's costing us a fortune in repairs!"

Desc.SourceString: 一份实验品逃逸的事故处理简报：「护理部应急小组介入后，于02:10前控制所有逃逸实验品。」
Desc.LocalizedString: An incident report on the escape of test subjects: "After the Nursing Department's emergency response team intervened, all escaped test subjects were contained by 02:10."

Desc.SourceString: 一份通讯记录：「未能保全冷山医院是我部门的失职，本次行动，护理部将不惜一切代价。」
Desc.LocalizedString: A communication record: "Failure to secure Coldmount Hospital is a dereliction of duty by this department. In this operation, the Nursing Department will spare no cost."

Desc.SourceString: 一份随意的日志：「N主任似乎搭上了个大客户，院长特批了一笔资金，为他们建立了一个专项研究小组……」
Desc.LocalizedString: A casual journal entry: "Director N seems to have landed a big client. The hospital director approved a special budget to establish a dedicated research group for them…"

Desc.SourceString: 一份关于某个异象的实验报告：「本报告内容仅限██组内查阅，不得外传。」
Desc.LocalizedString: An experiment report on a certain Anomaly: "This report is for the eyes of Group ██ only. Do not disclose."

Desc.SourceString: 一张字迹潦草的便条，夹在某人的备忘录里：「以防万一，得找个机会跟N聊聊。」
Desc.LocalizedString: A hastily scrawled note tucked into someone's memo: "Should find a chance to speak with N, just in case."

Desc.SourceString: 一份办公室内的排班记录：「仔细看这份排班表的话，似乎有哪里不对劲……」
Desc.LocalizedString: An employee scheduling record: "If you take a close look at this schedule, you'll notice something doesn't quite add up…"

Desc.SourceString: 一份病房内的护理记录表，记录着5号床██位患者的身体状况：「不幸的是，患者意外死亡。」
Desc.LocalizedString: A nursing record from the ward, documenting the condition of the patient in Room 5, ██: "Unfortunately, the patient has passed away."

Desc.SourceString: 一本被撕烂的实验日志，可能曾属于医院的某位助理护士：「这就是你想要的结局吗,V？」
Desc.LocalizedString: A torn experiment record, possibly once belonging to an assistant at the hospital: "Is this the ending you wanted, V?"

Desc.SourceString: 神秘的笔记，上面似乎记录着现实中所发生的事情：……这不是██第一次来这里。我很好奇，这座恐怖，阴森，毫无生机的医院，对你来说究竟有怎样的吸引力呢……我的结局早已注定……
Desc.LocalizedString: A mysterious note, seemingly recounting events that occurred at the hospital: …This isn't ███'s first time here. I'm curious—what kind of draw does this lifeless hospital have…? My fate was sealed long ago…

Desc.SourceString: 一个空的密闭罐，不知道曾经装过什么……
Desc.LocalizedString: An empty sealed container. No telling what used to be inside…

Desc.SourceString:
「闪影」
请务必确保该实验对象处于光照中，否则其随时可能以虚影的形态逃逸。
如发现光照状态下对象消失，请联系中心实验室。
如果发现无光照状态下对象仍存在，也请联系中心实验室。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Etcher
Maintain constant illumination on the test subject to prevent potential escape via its shadow state.
If the subject disappears while illuminated, contact the Central Laboratory.
If the subject remains visible in the absence of light, also contact the Central Laboratory.

Desc.SourceString:
「泅鬼」
需分隔保存，如观测到水中出现黑色阴影，需立即进行二分、保存于不同密闭罐中，直到水体中不再能观测到阴影。
严禁将该实验对象混入任何水体。
绝对严禁饮用或注射！
Desc.LocalizedString:
Drowner
Store in isolated, sealed containers. If a dark shadow is detected in the water, promptly split it into separate sealed containers until the shadow is no longer visible.
Under no circumstances should the test subject be exposed to any body of water.
Strictly prohibit ingestion or injection.

Desc.SourceString: 一幅画，还有一个姿势奇怪的……人偶？
Desc.LocalizedString: A painting, and a… figurine in a strange pose?

Desc.SourceString: 画里的门，在现实中打开了……
Desc.LocalizedString: The door in the painting… just opened in reality…

Desc.SourceString: 房间中间的画作和墙上的影子，有些相似……
Desc.LocalizedString: The painting in the middle of the room and the shadow on the wall look somewhat similar…

Desc.SourceString: 新的房间，看起来更复杂了。再往里走些看看……
Desc.LocalizedString: A new room, and it looks more complex. Let's head in a bit further…

Desc.SourceString: 画布上的背景，和雕塑的背景很相似。只是，有一些光线上的区别……
Desc.LocalizedString: The background on the canvas and sculpture are very similar. However, there are some differences in the lighting…

Desc.SourceString: 看来「视角」是解谜的关键。
Desc.LocalizedString: So the key to solving this is the view.

Desc.SourceString: 这里好暗啊……有没有哪里能开个灯呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so dark in here… Is there somewhere I can turn on a light?

Desc.SourceString: 门外没有其他房间……终于结束了。
Desc.LocalizedString: No more rooms beyond this door… It's finally over.

Desc.SourceString: （之后或许可以找些硬东西试试。比如说……汤匙？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Maybe I can find something to dig with later. Maybe… a spoon?)

Desc.SourceString: （呼，拿到了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Phew, got it.)

Desc.SourceString: （……糟糕，被发现了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (…Shoot, I've been spotted.)

Desc.SourceString: 已经是深夜了，似乎无事可做。要按作息规定上床休息吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's already late at night and there doesn't seem to be much to do. Would you like to go to bed according to your schedule?

Desc.SourceString: （没听过的名字……为什么人们总是对陌生人的八卦这么感兴趣？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Never heard that name before… Why are people always so interested in gossiping about strangers?)

Desc.SourceString: 「隐火症」，涉异病症，初次发现于冷山医院，可传染，方式未知，无治愈手段。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phantom Burn Syndrome. An anomaly-related disorder first discovered at Coldmount Hospital. Contagious through unknown means. No known cure.

Desc.SourceString: 冷山医院的一切都是施特林家族的财产，包括他们的病，他们的生，他们的死。
Desc.LocalizedString: Everything at Coldmount Hospital is the property of the Stirling family. Their illnesses, their lives, their deaths.
