Desc.SourceString: （看来管教已经发现我离开了，之后路上得更小心避开搜查才行。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like the guards have already noticed I'm gone. I'll have to be more careful to avoid their search from here on out.)

Desc.SourceString: （值班的管教就在附近……今晚还是别轻举妄动了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The guard is nearby… Better not make any rash moves tonight.)

Desc.SourceString: （这个时间有管教在巡视，还是等宵禁后再说吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The guards are patrolling at this hour. Better wait until after curfew.)

Desc.SourceString: （这水又深又浑浊，直接蹚水过去恐怕不好走。还是别在水道中行动了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This water is deep and murky. Wading through would be difficult. Better stay out of the waterway.)

Desc.SourceString: （这条通道通向拘留所，最好不要贸然进去。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This passage leads to the detention center. Better not go in there carelessly.)

Desc.SourceString: （这个洞口已经被堵上了啊……没办法，这次再找找其他脱身的方法吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The hole has been sealed up… Oh well, guess I'll have to find another way out this time.)

Desc.SourceString: 发病早期，患者会因身体局部的灼痛感而情绪不稳定、出现自毁倾向……
Desc.LocalizedString: In the early stages, patients experience localized burning sensations that cause emotional instability and self-destructive tendencies…

Desc.SourceString: 即使在并无烧伤的情况下，患者也会要求用绷带对患处进行包扎，这种方式疑似能减轻其灼痛感和不安心理。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even in the absence of actual burns, patients will request bandages to wrap the affected areas. This method appears to alleviate their burning pain and psychological distress.

Desc.SourceString: 发病中期，症状会逐步扩散，患者会尽可能地用绷带包裹自己的肢体甚至头部，严重影响活动，
Desc.LocalizedString: In the middle stage, symptoms gradually spread. Patients will wrap as much of their limbs and even their heads in bandages as possible, severely impairing mobility.

Desc.SourceString: 同时，将无法进行沟通，停止进食，丧失睡眠，任何尝试摘下绷带的举动会引发剧烈的反抗。
Desc.LocalizedString: They will also become unable to communicate, cease eating, and lose the ability to sleep. Any attempt to remove the bandages will trigger violent resistance.

Desc.SourceString: 从家族将这一批实验品以患者的名义收入冷山医院时，我就已经做好了最坏的打算。
Desc.LocalizedString: From the moment the family admitted this batch of test subjects under the guise of patients, I had already prepared for the worst.

Desc.SourceString: 但我从未想过，最终的差错竟然出在一个小小的实验员身上。
Desc.LocalizedString: But I never imagined that the final mishap would come down to a mere researcher.

Desc.SourceString: 家族给所有人许诺了财富与健康，也包括他在内。可为何他要背叛？
Desc.LocalizedString: The family promised everyone wealth and health, him included. So why did he betray us?

Desc.SourceString: 因为对那些本就无法治愈之人产生了怜悯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Was it out of pity for those who were beyond saving?

Desc.SourceString: 你好好好好好好，要帮忙开门吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: He-he-he-hello there… Need help opening the door…?

Desc.SourceString: 外面的楼层变成了未知的异象空间……
Desc.LocalizedString: The floor outside turned into an anomalous realm…

Desc.SourceString: 怎么卡住了？……要用这个按钮吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why is it stuck? …Is it this button?

Desc.SourceString: 不妙，得赶紧关上电梯门！
Desc.LocalizedString: This is bad! I need to close the elevator now!

Desc.SourceString: 按钮被冲走了，在外面的异象空间里……
Desc.LocalizedString: The water flushed the button into the anomalous realm…

Desc.SourceString: 这里莫非就是，那黑水异象产生的地方？
Desc.LocalizedString: Could this be… where the black water anomaly is from?

Desc.SourceString: 漏水的位置在最下层，水往上层爬……这确实很难想到啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: The leak started at the bottom floor, but the water climbed upwards… This is hard to figure out.

Desc.SourceString: 据悉，假如能将异常的楼道恢复正常，也能成功返回电梯……
Desc.LocalizedString: According to reports, if you can restore the anomalous hallway to normal, you'll be able to return to the elevator…

Desc.SourceString: 本电梯自即日起进行封锁，无关人员严禁入内。如有擅自闯入者，后果自负！
Desc.LocalizedString: This elevator is sealed off effective immediately. Unauthorized personnel are strictly prohibited from entering. Trespassers will face consequences at their own risk!

Desc.SourceString: 《冒牌猎人擅闯异象电梯，谁来担责？》
Desc.LocalizedString: Fake Hunter Trespasses Into Anomaly Elevator—Who's Responsible?

Desc.SourceString: 电梯按钮缺失，需要补全后使用。
Desc.LocalizedString: The elevator button is missing. I need to find it first.

Desc.SourceString: （门上锁了……之前好像见到有管教带着一串钥匙，说不定能在监舍楼里找到这扇门的钥匙。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Locked… I spotted a keyring on a guard earlier. Maybe the key to this door is somewhere in the cellblock.)

Desc.SourceString: （门锁似乎被换过了……看来速降这条路行不通了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The lock seems to have been changed… Rappelling is not going to work.)

Desc.SourceString: （下水道栅栏似乎锈得很厉害，用强腐蚀性的化学药品应该能让它断裂。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The sewer grates looks badly rusted. A highly corrosive chemical should be able to break it.)

Desc.SourceString: （下水道口已经换上了新栅栏，看来得另想脱身的办法了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The sewer entrance already has a new grate. Looks like I have to find another way out.)

Desc.SourceString: （这样贸然行动会被发现的，得想办法支开医生再动手。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I'll get caught if I'm too careless. I have to distract the doctor before making a move.)

Desc.SourceString: （药剂似乎起效了，等明天再来看看情况吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The chemical is working. I'll take a look tomorrow.)

Desc.SourceString: （找些拘留服和床单，应该能制成速降绳。这个高度……应该四件就够了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Rappelling Rope can be made from Prisoner's Uniforms and Bed Sheets. This height should take… about two of each.)

Desc.SourceString: （这药……见效好快……头好晕……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The chemical… is working too fast… so dizzy…)

Desc.SourceString: （嗯，这个大小足够我钻过去了。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Alright, this should be big enough for me to crawl through.)

Desc.SourceString: 喂！给我站住，不许动！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Freeze! Don't move!

Desc.SourceString: 一个空的密封罐，标签上的文字已经模糊不清，隐约能看到「拼拼」几个字样，底下似乎压着什么东西……
Desc.LocalizedString: An empty sealed jar. The text on the label is blurred and illegible, but you can faintly make out the word: "Jigsaw". There seems to be something pressed underneath it…

Desc.SourceString: 一个坏掉的钟表，指针也已经生锈，不过它的后面似乎有什么东西……
Desc.LocalizedString: A broken clock, its hands rusted and old—yet there seems to be something behind it…

Desc.SourceString: （如果给{Gender}|gender(他,她)一把汤匙，让{Gender}|gender(他,她)送进配电房，说不定可以让监舍楼的电力系统短路……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (If I give {Gender}|gender(him,her) a spoon and have {Gender}|gender(him,her) sneak it into the electrical room, it might short-circuit the power system in the cell block…)

Desc.SourceString: （糟糕，这里有管教在巡逻，得想办法引开{Gender}|gender(他,她)。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Not good—there's a guard on patrol. Gotta lure {Gender}|gender(him,her) away.)

Desc.SourceString: （管教应该会被吸引过来，在那之前赶紧找地方躲起来吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The guard should be lured over there. Gotta find somewhere to hide before then.)

Desc.SourceString: （似乎上锁了，在刚刚的门厅前台处或许能找到钥匙。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like it's locked. The key might be at reception in the entrance hall.)

Desc.SourceString: （门锁似乎损坏了，无法从这一侧打开。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like the lock is busted. I can't open it from this side.)

Desc.SourceString: （管教又回到这里巡逻了，从旁边的房间绕到前台吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The guard's patrolling here again. I have to sneak through the next room and loop around to reception.)

Desc.SourceString: （这个收音机的电路……如果有尖锐的金属物品的话，或许可以让它短路。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (The radio's circuitry… With something sharp and metallic, I could short it out.)

Desc.SourceString: （成功了，应该不会被看出是人为的……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (It worked. They shouldn't realize it was on purpose…)

Desc.SourceString: （终于出来了。趁管教还没有追上来，赶紧前往码头吧。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Finally made it out. Gotta get to the wharf before the guards catch up.)

Desc.SourceString: （现在出去应该不会被发现。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (If I go now, I shouldn't get noticed.)

Desc.SourceString: （飞镖？为什么会藏在书里……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (A dart? Why's it hidden in a book…?)

Desc.SourceString:
「棉绒绒」
该实验对象被激怒或是受到伤害后会改变形态，需确保其保持现有形态。
若观察到形态转变，请联系中心实验室。
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Fluffy"
This specimen will change its form if provoked or injured; ensure it remains in its current form.
If you observe any changes in form, contact the Central Laboratory.

Desc.SourceString:
「拼拼」（？型）
该实验对象本体可人为分裂为最少四个单元，通常用作保密优先级较高的空间生物锁，需将该样本与其他碎片完整组合后方可打开特定空间。
具有较高的医学研究价值，可与█████████，尚在研究中。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Jigsaw (Type ?) 
This experimental subject's body can be artificially divided into at least four or more sections. It is generally used as a Bio-lock space requiring high levels of security to access; the sample itself must be fully recombined with its other fragments, or "pieces," before a specific space can be opened.
It holds significant medical research value and may be combined with █████████; investigation is still ongoing.

Desc.SourceString:
「失躯者」（部分）
该实验对象真实形态为扭曲人形轮廓的绷带空壳，部分个体具有奇特的习性，如趋光、会被声音吸引等。
严禁触碰该实验样本！
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Bodiless" (Section)
The specimen's true form is a bandage-wrapped shell with a twisted humanoid silhouette; some exhibit peculiar behaviors, such as being drawn to the universe or puppeted by sound.
Any physical interaction with this specimen is strictly prohibited!

Desc.SourceString:
「谜皮鬼」
已知该实验对象可以变幻为与自身大小相仿的物体，如果对象形态发生改变，无须理会。
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Mysty"
This experimental object is known to be able to transform into other objects roughly similar in size. If the object's form changes, ignore it.

Desc.SourceString: 一个空的密封罐，标签上有「拼拼」的字样，但里面的东西不知被谁拿走了……
Desc.LocalizedString: An empty sealed jar labeled "Jigsaw"—whatever was inside has been taken by someone…

Desc.SourceString:
「回环时钟」
请确保该实验对象形态完整，处于正常工作状态，如果发现其指针转动异常或是被破坏，立刻联系中心实验室。
严禁与该对象长时间处于同一空间。
Desc.LocalizedString:
"Looping Clock"
Ensure the specimen's form is intact and operating normally. If its hands rotate abnormally or it has been damaged recently, contact the Central Laboratory immediately.
Remaining in the same space as this specimen for extended periods of time is strictly prohibited.

Desc.SourceString: 不会让你……伤到鉴定师的。
Desc.LocalizedString: I won't let you… hurt the Appraiser.

Desc.SourceString: 异象……还是这么讨厌……
Desc.LocalizedString: Anomalies… still so annoying…

Desc.SourceString: 赶、赶上了！请，交给我吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: J-Just in time! Leave this to me.

Desc.SourceString: 希、希望有……有帮到你。
Desc.LocalizedString: H-Hope I helped… you.

Desc.SourceString: 结束了……下次，总、总之，有需要的话还可以找我。
Desc.LocalizedString: That's it… I-I'll always be there to help.

Desc.SourceString: 呼——待会要……临时通知要加班，我、我先走了……下次见。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew—Do you want… Oh, I need to work overtime. See you… next time!

Desc.SourceString: 注意安全，加、加油！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stay safe! Y-You got this!

Desc.SourceString: 分、分给你，要赢呀……
Desc.LocalizedString: H-Here. Please win…

Desc.SourceString: 振作起来，我相信你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Get yourself together. I believe in you!

Desc.SourceString: 你还好吧，鉴定师？一个人对付这家伙太危险了，让我们也来帮忙吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you okay? It's dangerous to fight this one alone. Let us help!

Desc.SourceString: 稳住节奏，我们会配合你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Steady your pace. We'll assist you.

Desc.SourceString: 没想到会在这种地方遇到你……还好我就在附近。
Desc.LocalizedString: Didn't think I'll meet you here… Luckily, I was around.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然你可能不愿意麻烦身边的人，但千万别因此让自己受伤呀。以后遇到困难，一定要及时寻求帮助。
Desc.LocalizedString: You might not want to trouble others, but don't risk getting hurt. Remember, seek help if you ever need it.

Desc.SourceString: 呼，刚才好险啊……还好你平安无事。
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew, that was close… Glad you're okay.

Desc.SourceString: 想起了以前当异象猎人的日子……好怀念啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: That reminded me my days as an Anomaly Hunter. Good times.

Desc.SourceString: 累了吗，鉴定师？不要太勉强自己，我们一起解决它。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you okay? Don't overwork yourself. We'll do this together.

Desc.SourceString: 就快战胜它了，不要放弃！
Desc.LocalizedString: We're getting there. Don't give up!

Desc.SourceString: 调整呼吸，按你自己的节奏来就好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Catch your breath and find your own pace.

Desc.SourceString: （这里的针头或许能用来注射「静息灵」。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (This needle might work to inject Restinol.)

Desc.SourceString: （《放弃幻想，好好改造》、《成为一个对社会有帮助的人》、《感动海特洛特刊》……大多都是这种风格的书和杂志。）
Desc.LocalizedString: ("Abandon Your Fantasies, Get Properly Reformed," "How to Be Actually Useful to Society," "Hethereau: Heartwarming Special"… most of the books and magazines are this sort of thing.)

Desc.SourceString: （没想到这里居然还有漫画……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Didn't expect to find manga here…)

Desc.SourceString: 往这！
Desc.LocalizedString: This way!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么这么快就没影了？
Desc.LocalizedString: How did we lose them already?

Desc.SourceString: 他们进废弃工地了，走。
Desc.LocalizedString: They entered the Abandoned Construction Site.

Desc.SourceString: 哟，捅到老巢了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Aha, looks like we found their den.

Desc.SourceString: 正好把你们一锅端了。
Desc.LocalizedString: We'll deal with you all at once.

Desc.SourceString: 刚才那两个人不在这啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: The two we just followed aren't here…

Desc.SourceString: 去楼上看看！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's check upstairs.

Desc.SourceString: 我听到了你的召唤，所以来到这里——诶？你说你没喊我吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I got here after hearing your call. Wait, what do you mean you didn't call me?

Desc.SourceString: 哟，不介意多个帮手吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, don't mind me lending a hand?

Desc.SourceString: 这家伙可不好对付，我来搭把手吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: This one is pretty tough. Let me help!

Desc.SourceString: 收工！下次再见咯！
Desc.LocalizedString: All done! See you next time!

Desc.SourceString: 总感觉意犹未尽啊……不过当然了，还是安全结束战斗最重要！
Desc.LocalizedString: That wasn't nearly enough… Well, ending the fight with all limbs is still the priority.

Desc.SourceString: 呼，没出什么岔子……那我就先走了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Phew, that went well… I'll be off!

Desc.SourceString: 趁现在，火力全开吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Now is the time to go all in!

Desc.SourceString: 进攻的好时机！
Desc.LocalizedString: It's time to attack!

Desc.SourceString: 一起上吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's do it!

Desc.SourceString: 看来你们正打得火热，不介意的话，就让我也加入吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: You're all caught up in the heat of the moment. I'm joining if that's okay.

Desc.SourceString: 别分心，我来掩护你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Stayed focused. I'll cover you.

Desc.SourceString: 保护好自己，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, keep yourself safe.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然我不擅长协同作战，不过，跟你合作的感觉还不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm not great in teamfights, but I enjoyed fighting alongside you.

Desc.SourceString: 如果觉得我抢了你的猎物，我可以改天请你吃顿饭。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you think I stole your target, I can buy you a meal to compensate.

Desc.SourceString: 希望下次遇到你不是在这种地方。
Desc.LocalizedString: I hope the next time we meet isn't in a place like this.

Desc.SourceString: 是时候了，全力攻击！
Desc.LocalizedString: it's time to go all in!

Desc.SourceString: 到动真格的时候了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Give it everything you've got!

Desc.SourceString: 让人火大……速战速决！
Desc.LocalizedString: Annoying… I'll make it fast!

Desc.SourceString: 哇啊，鉴定师好辛苦的样子……我来帮忙吧~！
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah, you're having a hard time… Let me help!

Desc.SourceString: 好大只的坏家伙！我们一起打倒它吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: That's a big bad one! Let's beat it together!

Desc.SourceString: 不管你需不需要，总之我来帮忙啦~！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whether you need me or not, I'm here to help!

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，要迟到了，我先走啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Oww, I'm getting late. See ya!

Desc.SourceString: 圆满完成任务~再见啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mission complete. Goodbye!

Desc.SourceString: 结束了呢。下次再见咯~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a wrap. See you next time!

Desc.SourceString: 用更大的力气，揍扁坏家伙吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Beat the baddies with more power!

Desc.SourceString: 再用力一点！还要让它更痛、更痛才行呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hit harder! Give them more pain!

Desc.SourceString: 加油~加油~
Desc.LocalizedString: Go, go, go!

Desc.SourceString: 要是累了，就做个梦吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Dream a little dream if you get tired!

Desc.SourceString: 小羊们，快帮帮鉴定师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Kiddos, help the Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 伊刻洛斯，准备打针！
Desc.LocalizedString: Icelos, prepare for injection!

Desc.SourceString: 找到了！鉴定师——这个电波，果然是你没错！
Desc.LocalizedString: Found you, Appraiser! I knew this frequency was yours!

Desc.SourceString: 看得本恶灵手痒了——小鬼！我们上！
Desc.LocalizedString: This evil spirit is getting restless! Scamp, let's go!

Desc.SourceString: 求助信号已接收，E.T.D六队灵可、开始支援！
Desc.LocalizedString: Help signal received. Linko from ETD-6 is here to support!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，没有受伤吧？唔……没有就好！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser, are you hurt? Oh… I'm glad you're okay!

Desc.SourceString: 呼~刚才配合得真好，果然我和鉴定师的电波是同频的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whew! We work well together. I knew we were in sync!

Desc.SourceString: 就算是战斗的时候，鉴定师的电波也一点都不刺耳呢……希望下次也能联机作战！
Desc.LocalizedString: Your frequency isn't noisy even when you fight… I hope we can do another co-op!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，这个给你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser, this is for you.

Desc.SourceString: 喂！挂彩了可别硬扛啊~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Don't strain yourself if you're hurt!

Desc.SourceString: 胜利的电波在召唤我们！
Desc.LocalizedString: The frequency of victory… is calling out for us!

Desc.SourceString: 不在邀请名单上的客人？莫非，您是我们等待已久的乐师？
Desc.LocalizedString: A guest who's not on the list? Are you the musician we've been waiting for?

Desc.SourceString: 冒紫火的，还防水……在雨天，这篝火确实会很显眼。
Desc.LocalizedString: Purple smoke and doesn't get put out by the rain… this signal can't be clearer.

Desc.SourceString: 那么在这里碰头的——会是什么人呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: I wonder what kind of person I'm going to be meeting here?

Desc.SourceString: 「我的王，于黄金树下小憩」
Desc.LocalizedString: "My king rests beneath the Golden Tree."

Desc.SourceString:
「日落，月升，星星也被你擦拭。」
「而那归乡路即便显现，尽头也只见茫茫焦土……」
Desc.LocalizedString:
"The sun sets, the moon rises, and even the stars are polished by your hand."
"Yet even when the road home appears, its end reveals only endless scorched earth…"

Desc.SourceString:
「王啊，从一开始我们就知道——」
「此处，并非黄金乡。」
Desc.LocalizedString:
"O King, we knew from the very beginning—"
"This place was never the Golden Land."

Desc.SourceString: 「国不再是国；而我的王，迷失于黄金乡。」
Desc.LocalizedString: "The kingdom is a kingdom no more; and my king is lost within the Golden Land."

Desc.SourceString: 也许……我可以试试，「一直游到海水变白」……
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe… I could give it a try… "swim until the water turns to foam"…

Desc.SourceString: 黑色苔藓，特殊的异味，下水道……
Desc.LocalizedString: Black moss, weird smell, sewers…

Desc.SourceString: 就是这里。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here it is.

Desc.SourceString: 真红平时的休息日都会怎么过？
Desc.LocalizedString: Shinku, what do you usually do on days off?

Desc.SourceString: 可能会出去逛逛，也可能就待在家里，总之看心情。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sometimes I go out shopping. Sometimes I stay home. Depends on the mood.

Desc.SourceString: 不考虑跟朋友们一起吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you go out with friends?

Desc.SourceString: 偶尔薄荷也会吵着闹着让我跟她一起出去玩，当然我更习惯一个人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint occasionally blabbers about going out with me. Of course, I'm more used to being by myself.

Desc.SourceString: 毕竟我算是个比较随性，想到哪是哪的人，如果约人出去玩的话会让对方觉得很无聊吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm a bit of a random person. I go wherever I feel like. If someone goes out with me, don’t you think they'll get bored?

Desc.SourceString: 不过，最近我也在想……
Desc.LocalizedString: But I've been thinking…

Desc.SourceString: ……或许，我也该多跟朋友们相处试试。
Desc.LocalizedString: …maybe I should try harder to get along with friends.

Desc.SourceString: 毕竟真红并不排斥跟朋友们一起，不是吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You don't really dislike being with friends, do you?

Desc.SourceString: 是啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't.

Desc.SourceString: 到了，跟我来吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: We're here. Follow me.

Desc.SourceString: 打得慢吞吞的，本绵都快没兴致了！
Desc.LocalizedString: You're moving way too slow—this Fuzzy's getting bored!

Desc.SourceString: 呜，好冷。绵坚持不了多久的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Brr… it's so cold. This little Fuzzy can't last much longer…

Desc.SourceString: 打快点，绵想回去睡觉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hurry up. I'm gonna go back to sleep.

Desc.SourceString: 你还有三十秒的时间用来逃跑——或者战胜绵。
Desc.LocalizedString: You've got thirty seconds left to run—or beat this Fuzzy.

Desc.SourceString: 太暗了，要小心脚下。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's dark. Mind your steps.

Desc.SourceString: 呀！差点摔个大跟头。好险好险。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooh! I almost flopped big time. Lucky me.

Desc.SourceString: 哇，简直像妈妈的肚子里一样黑呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow, it's as dark as mommy's belly!

Desc.SourceString: 黑暗视觉什么的……啧，果然没有啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Dark vision… Tch, it's not like I expected to have it.

Desc.SourceString: 剑被烤得好烫啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: My sword is scathing hot…

Desc.SourceString: 好想吃……碎雪冰淇淋……商绵那里会有吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I want… Blizzi Ice Cream… will the Merchant Fuzzy have it?

Desc.SourceString: 热到一点力气都没有啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's so hot, I'm out of steam already!

Desc.SourceString: 完全提不起劲继续走啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: I don't really wanna keep going…

Desc.SourceString: 在这么冷的地方待上一会儿，就有点怀念之前的火山了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Now that I'm in such a cold place, I kind of miss the volcano before…

Desc.SourceString: 觉得冷吗？大家快离我近一点——这样比较暖和！
Desc.LocalizedString: Feeling cold? Come near me! It's warmer that way!

Desc.SourceString: 小羊们的皮毛成分都是100%羊毛，所以不会觉得冷呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: The kiddos won't feel cold at all. Their jackets are made of 100% wool.

Desc.SourceString: 一冷起来就开始犯困了……
Desc.LocalizedString: This cold is making me sleepy…

Desc.SourceString: 好浓的雾，大家小心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Careful. The fog is too thick.

Desc.SourceString: 这么大的雾，真担心会落单啊……但一闻到大家的气味就安心了！
Desc.LocalizedString: This fog makes me worry about getting lost… but I feel safe as long as I can smell everyone!

Desc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯，不要乱飞哦。要是迷路了就再也回不去了呢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Phantasos, don't fly away. If you get lost, you won't ever come back!

Desc.SourceString: 穿行在这么浓的雾里，就像被雨淋湿了一样。好烦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Annoying. This thick fog makes me feel I'm soaked in the rain.

Desc.SourceString: 真想使出「终极薄荷奥义之托马斯回旋疾风斩」，把热气通通吹走！
Desc.LocalizedString: I really wanna get rid of the heat with my "Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash"!

Desc.SourceString: 点满力量的「终极……中间忘了疾风斩」，威力一定很可观吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: With max strength, your "Ultimate Super… I can't remember slash" would be incredible!

Desc.SourceString: 噫！好烫好烫……我的尾巴是不是着火了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Eeek! It's burning… Is my tail catching fire?

Desc.SourceString: 我来看看……嗯，沾到岩浆变成热巧克力猫了哦，变得更香甜了~！
Desc.LocalizedString: Lemme see… Lava has turned you into a volcano chocolate kitty! Smells amazing!

Desc.SourceString: 好热啊……感觉要融化了……
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm so warm… I'm gonna melt…

Desc.SourceString: 遇热就融化……猫果然是液体。
Desc.LocalizedString: Melting in the heat…? I guess cats really are liquid.

Desc.SourceString: 嘶，可可的手好冰！哈……这样有暖和些吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Sssss! Coco, your hands are so cold! *Huff*… did that help a bit?

Desc.SourceString: 谢谢你薄荷，帮大忙了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks, Mint. It helped a lot.

Desc.SourceString: 茶茶，你在发抖耶！快过来我身后，风会小一点！
Desc.LocalizedString: Teana, you're shivering! Get behind me! I'll block some of the wind!

Desc.SourceString: 「薄荷」明明是凉丝丝的口味，薄荷前辈却总给人暖烘烘的印象呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint should be cool and chilling, but Mint senpai is always warm and kind!

Desc.SourceString: 果果你冷不冷？不用客气，尽管把我当成暖手宝吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taya, are you cold? You know, you can treat me like I'm your hand warmer!

Desc.SourceString: 唔啊，真的好暖和……难怪人们都说笨蛋不会感冒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Woah, you're so warm… I guess it's true that dumcats don't catch colds.

Desc.SourceString: 这片湖的糖浆味也太浓了……感觉短时间内都不想碰甜食了。
Desc.LocalizedString: This lake is oozing with a sugary smell… I'm gonna quit sweets for a while.

Desc.SourceString: 游戏结束后，一起去吃胖达火锅怎么样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't we all go to Panda Hotpot after this?

Desc.SourceString: 哇！我刚刚碰到了什么东西！软乎乎、毛茸茸的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah! What did I just touch? It's furry and fuzzy!

Desc.SourceString: 伊刻洛斯，又在调皮哦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Icelos, you're playing around again!

Desc.SourceString: 疼疼……果果，那是我的尾巴！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ouchy, ouch…! Taya, that's my tail!

Desc.SourceString: 啊？我以为是藤蔓挡路，下意识就……抱歉。
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? I thought it was one of the vines in my way… Sorry, I wasn't thinking.

Desc.SourceString: 岩浆里会不会有小鱼在游呢？是鉴定师的话肯定能把它钓起来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Are there any fish swimming in the lava? Appraiser, you can catch one, can't you?

Desc.SourceString: 钓……烤鱼吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Catching… grilled fish?

Desc.SourceString: 应该把薄荷前辈的考卷也带来的。丢进岩浆里，很快就消失不见啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint senpai should have brought her exam sheets—just toss them into the lava and they're gone!

Desc.SourceString: 要是补考的烦恼能一起消失不见就好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: If only my troubles of passing make-up exams could be burned away.

Desc.SourceString: 看！那边！火山快喷发啦！不如我们叫它「暴躁龙的脾气」吧？~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey! Look! That volcano is about to explode! Let's call it "Ragezilla's Temper"!

Desc.SourceString: 想让你身边的这座也喷发是不是？
Desc.LocalizedString: You want this volcano to explode too, don't you?

Desc.SourceString: 如果这座山的冰雪全都融化，会不会变成牛奶瀑布呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: If all the snow on this mountain melts, would it form a waterfall made of milk?

Desc.SourceString: 那绵绵们恐怕都要变成奶油棉花糖了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Then the Fuzzies will become milkshake candy…

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷前辈~好暖和~
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint senpai! You're so warm!

Desc.SourceString: 有帮茶茶暖和起来就好！嘿嘿~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, I'm glad I'm warming you up, Teana.

Desc.SourceString: 啊嚏~一般说来，这么冷的天里，大家都会像这样打喷嚏对吧！我是不是学得还挺像？
Desc.LocalizedString: *Achoo!* People sneeze when it gets cold like this, don't they? Did I do it right?

Desc.SourceString: 你刚刚明明是被冻得真打喷嚏吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you pretend you didn't sneeze because of the cold!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么又有点困了~不过，我好像一直都在睡觉呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm getting drowsy… but I think I've always been sleeping!

Desc.SourceString: 没有做噩梦吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you get a nightmare?

Desc.SourceString: 和大家在一起的梦，当然不会是噩梦了~
Desc.LocalizedString: I dreamt with all of you, of course it wouldn't have been a nightmare!

Desc.SourceString: 小羊们，要跟紧哦。我来数数：一只小羊，两只小羊，三只小羊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey kiddos, follow close. Let me count: one little kid, two little kids, three little kids…

Desc.SourceString: ……嗯？不知道为什么，突然觉得好困……
Desc.LocalizedString: …Huh? For some reason, my eyes are getting super heavy…

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀？好像有一只小羊不见了~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my! Seems like a kid is missing!

Desc.SourceString: 在这里。是你的伙伴吧天线羊，好好照顾它们啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Here's your kid, Ramtenna. They're your companions. You need to take care of them.

Desc.SourceString: 好热……勇者能申请高温补贴吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's scorching… do we get extreme heat subsidies?

Desc.SourceString: 不知道这片大陆有没有给勇者发工资的机构……
Desc.LocalizedString: Does this continent even have organizations that give us salaries…?

Desc.SourceString: 简直就像大热天出外勤一样……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's like having a field mission on a scorching day…

Desc.SourceString: 但比雨天要强吧~
Desc.LocalizedString: Isn't that still better than a rainy day?

Desc.SourceString: 这下面可是岩浆，就算看到鱼也别忍不住去抓啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's lava down there. Don't even think about diving in to catch fish.

Desc.SourceString: 我才不会呢！真是的，果果心里的薄荷前辈究竟是什么形象！
Desc.LocalizedString: No way! Taya, why do you think this Mint senpai would do something like that?

Desc.SourceString: ……啧，好滑。鉴定师，小心脚下。
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch… it's slippery. Appraiser, mind your steps.

Desc.SourceString: 这里好像很容易滑倒……互相搭把手吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's easy to slip here… Let's hold hands with one another.

Desc.SourceString: 天线羊，你的天线是不是已经冻成一团硬邦邦的铁丝了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ramtenna, did your antennas freeze into stiff little wire balls?

Desc.SourceString: 有吗？那说不定可以拿下来当武器用诶。
Desc.LocalizedString: Did they? Maybe I can take them off and use them as weapons!

Desc.SourceString: 真羡慕你们这些毛茸茸的家伙……看上去就很暖和。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your furry coats seem so warm… Now I'm envious.

Desc.SourceString: 哼哼，等回去之后薄荷前辈就要用珍藏的毛茸茸帽子手套围巾把你包起来！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, when we get back, this Mint senpai will cover you with precious furry caps, gloves, and scarfs!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，没走散吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you still there?

Desc.SourceString: 别担心，我在。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I'm still here.

Desc.SourceString: 天线羊，你还在吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ramtenna, you there?

Desc.SourceString: 呀~莫非你有「分离焦虑症」？放心好了，我不会丢的~
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, do you actually have separation anxiety? Rest assured, I won't abandon you!

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷？是不是突然间又跑不见了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint? Where did she suddenly disappear to again?

Desc.SourceString: 我在的哟果果！抱歉抱歉，薄荷前辈让你担心了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Taya, I'm here! This Mint senpai made you worry—sorry about that!

Desc.SourceString: 这些岩浆，闻起来有股热巧克力的味道。
Desc.LocalizedString: This lava… somehow smells like hot chocolate.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯，和可可你的气味很像哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ya, it smells almost like you, Coco!

Desc.SourceString: 海特洛最热的时候，都比这里凉快得多……
Desc.LocalizedString: Even the hottest day in Hethereau is cooler than this…

Desc.SourceString: 也就只有那群棉花糖能在这种世界里生活了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Only those cotton candies want to live in a world like this…

Desc.SourceString: 突然很好奇，伊洛伊的小羊朋友们也会觉得热吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: I got a question, Iroi. Do your kids also feel scorched?

Desc.SourceString: 它们已经完全烤化啦~是不是这样呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: They've totally become roast mutton! Is that right?

Desc.SourceString: 唔，不小心吃到了一点……这些雪真的是甜的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooh, some snow fell on my tongue… it's actually sweet.

Desc.SourceString: 嘿嘿，有没有觉得我们其实是在攀爬一个巨大的牛奶冰淇淋？
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, don't you think it's like we're climbing a huge milk ice cream?

Desc.SourceString: 岩浆是热巧克力，积雪是冰牛奶，绵绵是棉花糖。那赤龙该不会也……
Desc.LocalizedString: The lava is hot chocolate, the snow is iced milk, the Fuzzies are cotton candies, so the Crimson Dragon is…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你偶尔也会想些奇怪的事啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, sometimes you have strange ideas.

Desc.SourceString: 化掉的小羊朋友们，现在还好吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are your roasted kids okay now?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯~它们被冻回原来的样子啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, they've been frozen back to shape!

Desc.SourceString: 这里能见度很差，大家提高警惕。
Desc.LocalizedString: Visibility is bad here. Everyone, stay on alert.

Desc.SourceString: 安心吧可可！我会好好守护你的背后的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you worry, Coco! Your back is safe with me!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？突然有什么动静……
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? Something's moving…

Desc.SourceString: 角又撞到东西了……放心，我没事。
Desc.LocalizedString: My horn hit something again… It's okay. I'm alright.

Desc.SourceString: 小羊朋友们没有迷路吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Your kids didn't get lost, did they?

Desc.SourceString: 它们牵着手就不会走散啦~要牵我的手吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: They'll be fine if they hold hands with each other. Do you want to hold mine?

Desc.SourceString: 现在还没有这枚棋子，再找找吧
Desc.LocalizedString: We don't have this piece yet. Keep looking.

Desc.SourceString: 出发！和柯林斯家族一代目共赴美食前线吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go! Head to the culinary frontline with the Ichi-daime of the Collucis!

Desc.SourceString: ……这种地方也能骑车吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You can cycle at a place like this…?

Desc.SourceString: 上次简森哥的车不就是开过来的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Didn't Jenson drive here a while ago?

Desc.SourceString: 我们要在这里骑上楼梯，然后左转哦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Head up the stairs, then turn left!

Desc.SourceString: 你确定吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you sure?

Desc.SourceString: 好好好，听你的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Order received, boss.

Desc.SourceString: 这路线真的能到吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Is this route even right?

Desc.SourceString: 我可是荣耀的柯林斯家族一代目！绝对不可能有错的！
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm the honorable Ichi-daime of the Collucis! There's no way I can be wrong!

Desc.SourceString: 注意注意，前面巷子口要右转！
Desc.LocalizedString: Attention! Turn right at the next alley!

Desc.SourceString: 我们从那边的楼梯上去，然后直行到马路再左转。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's climb up those stairs, then go straight and turn left on the road.

Desc.SourceString: 你要是不信……要不你闭眼骑，我睁眼指路，保准没错！
Desc.LocalizedString: If you don't believe me… just close your eyes and follow my orders!

Desc.SourceString: 看到胖达火锅店了！就在左面的十字路口。
Desc.LocalizedString: I see Panda Hotpot! It's at the intersection on the left!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么样，我没说错吧！一会儿的脑花说好分你的不会少，但最大的那块是我的！！
Desc.LocalizedString: Heheh, told ya, I was right! I'll share my offal with you, but I'll keep the largest piece!

Desc.SourceString: 左转左转！……你该不会是在怀疑本一代目的方向感吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn left! Are you… doubting the Ichi-daime's sense of direction?

Desc.SourceString: 喂喂喂，这可不是通往柯林斯家族荣耀之路的方向啊！快掉头！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, hey, the glorious path of the Coluccis is not this way! Turn around already!

Desc.SourceString: 前面路口右转……看路看路！别看我！
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn right at the next corner… Look at the road, not at me!

Desc.SourceString: 直走，然后——诶等等，这附近好像有家店的脆青花鱼很好吃……不对不对，正事要紧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Go forward, then… Wait, there's a place with great crunchy mackerel around… No, we must focus on the mission at hand!

Desc.SourceString: 路况有点复杂？很正常～感觉有点晕？也是正常的！
Desc.LocalizedString: The route is messy? That's normal! Feeling dizzy? That's also normal!

Desc.SourceString: 还没到吗？我的腿都坐麻了……
Desc.LocalizedString: We there yet? My legs are getting numb…

Desc.SourceString: 咔叽玛，好多人……
Desc.LocalizedString: Clicky, so many people…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯。番茄酱，很好吃……
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm. Ketchup, yummy…

Desc.SourceString: 啊，纳库佩达公园。
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, the Nacupeda Park.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，可以去公园里吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can we go inside?

Desc.SourceString: 不是。公园里，有贩卖机。想买番茄酱……
Desc.LocalizedString: No. In park, there's vending machine. Wanna buy, Tomato Jelly…

Desc.SourceString: 贩卖机，有番茄酱卖。
Desc.LocalizedString: Vending machine, sells Tomato Jelly.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，谢谢鉴定师。安魂曲，很快回来……
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, thanks, Appraiser. Lacrimosa, come back soon…

Desc.SourceString: 唔……今天要买衣服，不能去游戏厅。
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… Must buy clothes, can't play games.

Desc.SourceString: 好。和鉴定师，约好了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm. Appraiser, it's a promise.

Desc.SourceString: 他们的生意一直很不错。
Desc.LocalizedString: They've always been popular.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了安魂曲？是想要去许愿池许愿吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, do you want to make a wish at the pool?

Desc.SourceString: 那我们在这里先停一下吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Then let's stop here for a while.

Desc.SourceString: 那之后有机会，我们再去玩吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why don't we come back here some other time?

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷导航开始为您服务！
Desc.LocalizedString: Navigator Mint reporting to duty!

Desc.SourceString: 前面路口……左转！嗯嗯，肯定没错！
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn… left, at the crossroad. Ya, that must be right!

Desc.SourceString: 这个路口，我想想……继续左转！
Desc.LocalizedString: Here, lemme think… another left!

Desc.SourceString: 欸，怎么会这样……抱歉啊可可，之前好像是我弄错了，咱们还是先原路返回吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh nooo… Sorry, Coco, I got it wrong. Let's go back the way we came from…

Desc.SourceString: 没错，刚刚这个路口应该直行才对！
Desc.LocalizedString: Right, keep going forward at this intersection!

Desc.SourceString: 不对，这里怎么会出现金苹果藏馆？不应该啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wait, why are we at Gold Apple? This can't be right…

Desc.SourceString: 这、这么一说，好像确实有点眼熟……
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm, it does look familiar…

Desc.SourceString: 呜呜……对不起可可，我真的以为我记得路线来着……
Desc.LocalizedString: Waah… Sorry, Coco, I really thought I knew the way!

Desc.SourceString: 啊，前面就是浮冰影院！这次肯定没错了，我都看到广告牌了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, Floe Cinema is ahead! I'm sure we made it! I can even see its sign!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，前方路口左转！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, turn left ahead!

Desc.SourceString: 这个路口该……左、左转？
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn… le-left at this road?

Desc.SourceString: 这个路口右转！
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn right here!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，这里该右转……对、对吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, turn r-right… right?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯，就这样继续直行！
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, keep going forward!

Desc.SourceString: 我、我想想……继续直行……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Lemme think… let's move forward...?

Desc.SourceString: 这儿不是愿木坡吗？我记得去浮冰影院的路好像不经过这边吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Isn't this Yuanmu Hill? I think Floe Cinema is in another direction.

Desc.SourceString: 没关系，薄荷。你再好好想想。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's okay, Mint. Just tell me where to go.

Desc.SourceString: 刚刚好像来过这里……
Desc.LocalizedString: I think we just came from here…

Desc.SourceString: 薄荷，果然是迷路了吧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint, you got lost, didn't you…?

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，在这里左转如何？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, maybe turn left here?

Desc.SourceString: 最近的道路，确实是你说的那条。
Desc.LocalizedString: That is in fact the most efficient route.

Desc.SourceString: 不过，偶尔不那么「正确」，陪我绕绕远路……也挺有趣吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: But isn't it fun to not automatically take the "correct" path…? Take me on a detour.

Desc.SourceString: 听——多安静啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: Listen, it's so quiet.

Desc.SourceString: 呵呵……多美丽、多脆弱的花啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: (*Cackles*)… What beauty, what fragility in these blossoms…

Desc.SourceString: 凋落、枯死之后，这里又会是怎样一番景致呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: And what do they look like once they wither and die…?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？我记得这里该右转才对……
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm, I thought turning right was correct…

Desc.SourceString: 花瓣飘落的样子也很美呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: The falling petals make quite the scene.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……好困……回去的路就靠你了，招财宝……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ugh… so tired… Precious, I'm leaving it to you…
…Ugh.

Desc.SourceString: 从海边走吧招财宝，那边吹着海风舒服些。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's go by the sea. The breeze will make me feel better.

Desc.SourceString: 没错！
Desc.LocalizedString: Exactly!

Desc.SourceString: 呼~真是一个让人身心舒畅的大斜坡！
Desc.LocalizedString: Whew! Going down the slope feels great!

Desc.SourceString: 我们进海底隧道吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's ride into the undersea tunnel.

Desc.SourceString: 放心，这条隧道我走过不知道多少回了。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's okay. I've been through the tunnel countless times.

Desc.SourceString: 我保证我们完完整整进去，平平安安出来~
Desc.LocalizedString: Trust me, we'll enter the tunnel and leave in one piece!

Desc.SourceString: 听到火车咣当咣当的声音了吗，看来我们马上就要到目的地了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hear the rattling of the train? We're almost there.

Desc.SourceString: 那当然！你以为我这么多年古董白卖的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Of course! I didn't sell antiques all these years for nothing!

Desc.SourceString: 前面左转……嗯，是左转没错吧？……啊对，左转。
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn left ahead… Umm, it's a left, right? Oh, right… left.

Desc.SourceString: 一直走，别拐……别问我然后呢，到了我会说的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Keep going, don't turn… Don't ask me what's next. I'll tell you when we get there.

Desc.SourceString: 右转。诶慢点……那家橱窗里的瓶子还挺好看的，让我多看两眼。
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn right. Wait, slow down… that vase looks pretty nice. Let me take another look.

Desc.SourceString: 掉头掉头……这条路明显不对。嗯？你刚才也没发现？
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn around already… this isn't the right way. Hmm? You didn't know that already?

Desc.SourceString: 慢点，晃得我头晕……
Desc.LocalizedString: Slow down, I'm getting dizzy…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？前面好像有点不对劲……停一下，让我看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? There's something wrong ahead… Stop here. Let me see.

Desc.SourceString: 确定要走这条路？……行吧，一会儿堵车可别怪我没提醒你。
Desc.LocalizedString: Are you sure about this path? Fine… don't complain when the traffic gets in the way.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么不说话？……也好，那我眯一会儿。
Desc.LocalizedString: Got nothing to say? Fine… I'll close my eyes a bit.

Desc.SourceString: 你是说，从前面的斜坡下去吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You want me to… go down the slope ahead?

Desc.SourceString: 店长……我现在骑的可是自行车……
Desc.LocalizedString: Shopkeeper… I'm on a bicycle…

Desc.SourceString: 店长，距离这么远也能听清楚吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Shopkeeper, you can hear it from this far?

Desc.SourceString: 店长？别睡啊，你会摔下去的！
Desc.LocalizedString: Shopkeeper? Don't sleep! You'll fall off!

Desc.SourceString: 这一带很有烟火气，休憩时很适合来走走逛逛。
Desc.LocalizedString: This area is pretty lively. It must be nice to shop and relax around.

Desc.SourceString: 新赫兰德大部分区域都很繁华，像这样的地方反而不多见。
Desc.LocalizedString: Most places in New Herland are bustling with crowds. It's rare to find a place like this.

Desc.SourceString: 天色暗下来后，这些花也别有一番韵味。
Desc.LocalizedString: Once the sky darkens, the flowers look different.

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀……鉴定师，还是绕道吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh Appraiser… how about we detour?

Desc.SourceString: 桥间地倒是四处都是这样呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: This place reminds me more of Bridge Crossings.

Desc.SourceString: 没关系……我还……能坚持……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's okay… I can… keep going…
…Okay!

Desc.SourceString: 湖边的空气，很好呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: The air around here is fresh…

Desc.SourceString: 风也很温柔。
Desc.LocalizedString: The wind is nice too.

Desc.SourceString: 我我我……我抓稳了！
Desc.LocalizedString: I-I-I… will hold tight!

Desc.SourceString: 对、对不起！
Desc.LocalizedString: S-Sorry!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？是樱花。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? Cherry blossoms.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴、鉴定师……
Desc.LocalizedString: A-Appraiser…

Desc.SourceString: 有花瓣，落到你身上了。
Desc.LocalizedString: A flower fell on you.

Desc.SourceString: 我、我拿掉了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I-I took it off.

Desc.SourceString: 不、不是，不是麻烦。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's n-no trouble at all.

Desc.SourceString: 坐稳了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sit tight.

Desc.SourceString: 前面可能会有点颠簸。
Desc.LocalizedString: The road might be bumpy ahead.

Desc.SourceString: 也不用特别……
Desc.LocalizedString: That's a bit too…

Desc.SourceString: 风景真好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Great view.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What is it?

Desc.SourceString: 在哪？
Desc.LocalizedString: Where?

Desc.SourceString: 麻烦小吱了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Thanks for the trouble.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯，不是麻烦。
Desc.LocalizedString: Mhm, you're right.

Desc.SourceString: 在这里稍微停一下，麻烦啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: Stop here for a bit. Thanks!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师有玩过寻宝游戏吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you ever played a treasure-hunting game?

Desc.SourceString: 就是把线索一条条藏起来，引导着别人依次找到线索……最后找到宝物！
Desc.LocalizedString: You hide clues one after another, then guide the players to find them… until they get the treasure!

Desc.SourceString: 我现在就是在藏线索啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm hiding clues right now!

Desc.SourceString: 当然是薄荷前辈和聪明龙啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: Mint senpai and Smartzilla, of course!

Desc.SourceString: 不过，鉴定师要帮我保守秘密哦！不要告诉她们这些东西是我埋的~
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, please keep this a secret for me! Don't tell them I hid these clues!

Desc.SourceString: 这里……有什么需要处理的事情吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: What kind of errands… do you have here?

Desc.SourceString: 这么辛苦，只是为了玩寻宝游戏吗……
Desc.LocalizedString: All that work for a treasure-hunting game…?

Desc.SourceString: 伊洛伊打算让谁来玩这个游戏呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who are you planning to invite?

Desc.SourceString: 倒是毫无意外……
Desc.LocalizedString: Why am I not surprised…

Desc.SourceString: 好。
Desc.LocalizedString: Sure.

Desc.SourceString: ……去我家的路你知道怎么走吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you know how to get to my place…?

Desc.SourceString: 先往外面骑到铁心9号路上吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: You should get on Ironheart 9th Avenue first.

Desc.SourceString: 路对面能看到有家2-Four便利店就可以左转了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Turn left once you see the 2-Four across the road…

Desc.SourceString: ——啊，之后要通过铁路所以别骑太快。
Desc.LocalizedString: …Ah, don't go too fast when we're about to pass through the railway crossing.

Desc.SourceString: 刚好那里有几棵樱花树，我很推荐在那儿把速度放慢下来顺便赏个樱。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are a few cherry blossoms in that direction. I recommend slowing down to appreciate them.

Desc.SourceString: 很漂亮吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Aren't they pretty?

Desc.SourceString: 我很喜欢这里的氛围……而且还有好多人会特地跑来打卡。
Desc.LocalizedString: I really like the vibe here… A lot of people come here to post pictures on Bagel.

Desc.SourceString: 「小小麻雀」的店长就经常来，刚才她还送了我一件做成樱花样子的小装饰。
Desc.LocalizedString: The shop owner of Little Sparrow comes here often too. She just gave me a little sakura trinket.

Desc.SourceString: 我觉得更像是想留我继续……呃，还是别提了这个了。
Desc.LocalizedString: I think she's trying to poach me… Umm, let's not talk about it.

Desc.SourceString: 这边骑过去就快到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Go this way and we'll get there soon.

Desc.SourceString: 欣赏的时候是一码事……打扫就是另一码事了
Desc.LocalizedString: It's one thing to look at them and another to clean up…

Desc.SourceString: 每天回来都跟前一天一样满地的花瓣，永远也扫不完……
Desc.LocalizedString: Every day I come back to the same floor covered in petals, like they never get swept away…

Desc.SourceString: 收到，这位客人请坐好~
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, honorable guest. Please remain well-seated.

Desc.SourceString: 确实，连这条路两边也都是樱花。
Desc.LocalizedString: You're right, there are sakura trees on both sides here.

Desc.SourceString: 哦，刚才说的铁道口到了。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, we're at the railway crossing I was talking about.

Desc.SourceString: 真用心啊，这是答谢你特别活动的那天给她帮忙的额外报酬吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: How nice. Was it a gift to thank you for helping her out during the special event?

Desc.SourceString: 家门口都有樱花吗？这么奢侈~
Desc.LocalizedString: Cherry blossoms near your place? How lavish!

Desc.SourceString: 没错……就是……这副表情……
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes… That's the face I want to see…

Desc.SourceString: 白天那么热闹的地方，现在只能听到你我的呼吸声……
Desc.LocalizedString: A place so crowded during the day, but all you can hear now is us breathing…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 在海边的时候，一定要小心海鸥！
Desc.LocalizedString: You gotta watch out for seagulls when you're at the sea!

Desc.SourceString: 之前我在海边发呆的时候，一只海鸥突然俯冲过来……差点把我的呆毛叼走了！
Desc.LocalizedString: When I was gazing at the sea, a seagull dived at me… and almost plucked off my agohe!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 你的家里……是不是有弟弟妹妹呀？
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you have… younger siblings?

Desc.SourceString: 因为鉴定师骑车载着我的时候，骑得稳稳的，散发出的电波也很温和……
Desc.LocalizedString: Because when you carry me on your bike, you're steady and you let out a warm frequency…

Desc.SourceString: ……给人一种，很会照顾弟弟妹妹的印象？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's… like you must be good at taking care of younger siblings?

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……真好啊。
Desc.LocalizedString: That must be… so nice.

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 那个……欸？要说什么来着，我好像忘了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… huh? I was going to say something, but I forgot…

Desc.SourceString: 噢！想起来了！我好像……就是突然想叫你一声。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh! I remember now! I just… wanted to call you.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yay!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，好像有反应了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser, I sense something!

Desc.SourceString: 如果没弄错的话，应该就在……啊！抓到了！
Desc.LocalizedString: If I'm right, it should be… Ah! I caught one!

Desc.SourceString: 欸……不对，这个是「帆船獭」，我已经养了好多只了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh… this one is a Sailboat Tamachi. I have a few already…

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯！谢谢鉴定师！
Desc.LocalizedString: Alright! Thanks, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 噢！这次的电波很强大……应该会是很稀有的品种——
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh! I'm sensing a strong frequency… this has to be a rare one…

Desc.SourceString: 有反应了！啊……这次是……「贝集獭」。
Desc.LocalizedString: I got a response! Ah… it's… a Shell-out Tamachi.

Desc.SourceString: 它是擅长收集贝壳的经营高手，的确是超级强的稀有獭麻吉……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's an expert in collecting and selling shells. It's a super strong rare Tamachi alright…

Desc.SourceString: 那就麻烦鉴定师了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh?

Desc.SourceString: 海鸥怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What's wrong with seagulls?

Desc.SourceString: 好坏的海鸥！
Desc.LocalizedString: Bad seagulls!

Desc.SourceString: 怎么了？
Desc.LocalizedString: What is it?

Desc.SourceString: 记忆中应该是没有……为什么这么问？
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't remember any… Why do you ask?

Desc.SourceString: 这么说的话，如果把伊波恩的小家伙们考虑进来，也不能说是没有呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: If you put it that way, I guess the little ones at Eibon count.

Desc.SourceString: 什么事~
Desc.LocalizedString: What up?

Desc.SourceString: 没关系，想起来再说就好~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's alright. Just let me know when you remember.

Desc.SourceString: 那我就……回应你一句？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then I'll… respond?

Desc.SourceString: 那我们在附近找找？
Desc.LocalizedString: Should we look around?

Desc.SourceString: 那我们继续沿着海边找？
Desc.LocalizedString: Then we'll keep looking by the bay?

Desc.SourceString: 需不需要离海再近一些？
Desc.LocalizedString: Should we get closer to the sea?

Desc.SourceString: 好怪的名字。
Desc.LocalizedString: What a strange name.

Desc.SourceString: 那就是意外收获了。我们继续找吧，今天肯定能找到的~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a surprise reward then. Let's keep going. I'm sure we can find what you want today.

Desc.SourceString: 我也是顺路，没关系的~
Desc.LocalizedString: It's on the way. No big deal!

Desc.SourceString: 没想到居然能坐上鉴定师的车！
Desc.LocalizedString: I can't believe I get to be in your car!

Desc.SourceString: 哇……这里好漂亮，鱼在我们的头上飞来飞去……
Desc.LocalizedString: Wow… it's so pretty here. Fish are flying above us…

Desc.SourceString: 对它们来说，水面应该就相当于我们的天空。
Desc.LocalizedString: For them, the water surface must be like the sky.

Desc.SourceString: 唔……相当于它们的宇宙？我们相当于是外星人！
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm… it will be like outer space? That means we're aliens!

Desc.SourceString: 嗯嗯嗯嗯！就是这样！
Desc.LocalizedString: Yes, yes, yes! Exactly!

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师开车带我去抓獭麻吉！
Desc.LocalizedString: The Appraiser is driving me to catch a Tamachi!

Desc.SourceString: 那天空呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: What about the sky?

Desc.SourceString: 那这辆车，在它们眼中，就像是UFO飞船？
Desc.LocalizedString: And this car… must be like UFOs to the fish?

Desc.SourceString: 哈啊……这是在哪？为什么鉴定师在开车？
Desc.LocalizedString: *Yawn*… Where are we? Why is the Appraiser driving?

Desc.SourceString: 又给人家添麻烦……等等，臭小鬼，你衣服鞋子怎么都湿漉漉的？
Desc.LocalizedString: You're bothering someone again… Wait, scamp, why are your clothes and shoes drenched?

Desc.SourceString: 啧啧……你今天又掉进水里了吗？！下车赶紧把湿衣服换掉！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tch… did you fall into water again? Get off and get changed!

Desc.SourceString: 委托人是家具店的老板，因为店里最近一到晚上就会发生灵异事件，所以专门找到了我的呗果账号留言。
Desc.LocalizedString: The client is a furniture store owner. Paranormal incidents happen in the store when it gets late, so they sent a message to my Bagel account.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯……我是灵异区的UP主「乌鸫面」，平时魔女之家在网上也开放一些看风水运势的业务。
Desc.LocalizedString: So… I run a paranormal account called "Ravenoli," and sometimes when I'm at the Witch's House, I take fengshui commissions on the side.

Desc.SourceString: 不、不是。这次是……有报酬。很好的报酬。
Desc.LocalizedString: No, it's not that. The pay is… good. They prepared a great reward.

Desc.SourceString: 灵异事件？黑羽的账号和这个有关吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Paranormal incidents? Blackbird, does your account have content about those?

Desc.SourceString: 原来是这样。不过，你平时不大出门吧？这次是因为事件比较严重？
Desc.LocalizedString: I see. But you don't usually go out, right? You're going out this time because the incident sounds more serious?

Desc.SourceString: 「抢购促销商品」应该也算是种爱好吧，黑羽似乎很有这方面的天赋……？
Desc.LocalizedString: Getting promotional deals sounds like a hobby on its own. Blackbird seems to have a knack for it.

Desc.SourceString: 这辆车真的能放下那么多东西吗？或许需要一点收纳的技巧……
Desc.LocalizedString: Can this car really fit all the stuff? I'm going to have to use some packing skills…

Desc.SourceString: 超市门口堆放的商品是不是越来越多了……大概是错觉吧。
Desc.LocalizedString: Is the pile of stuff by the store entrance getting bigger…? I must be seeing things.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么想到去街机厅玩？
Desc.LocalizedString: Why are you hitting the arcade?

Desc.SourceString: 街机的话，我很擅长哦。
Desc.LocalizedString: You know, I'm good at arcade games.

Desc.SourceString: 那就来比比。
Desc.LocalizedString: Let's see who's better, then.

Desc.SourceString: 还不是哈尼娅这几天，天天在我耳边念叨，刚好今天有空，我就出来看看。
Desc.LocalizedString: Haniel's been nagging me the past few days about how fun it is. I got some time today and decided to check it out.

Desc.SourceString: 上次玩街机游戏，似乎还是在克莱门读书时候的事情了。
Desc.LocalizedString: The last time I went to an arcade, I was still a student at Clement.

Desc.SourceString: 嗯？那要来比比吗？先说好，我可不会放水的。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh? Should we see who's the better player? I won't go easy on you!

Desc.SourceString: 嘎吱……嘎吱、嘎吱……
Desc.LocalizedString: Creak… creak, creak…

Desc.SourceString: 架子上面的金属片……是为了加固特意包裹的紫铜？按照年份推测，这在当时可是奢侈品。
Desc.LocalizedString: The metal sheet on the easel… is that copper, wrapped for durability? This would have been a luxury back in the day.

Desc.SourceString: 这家的主人很爱护家具呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: The previous owner must have cared a lot about furniture.

Desc.SourceString: 比寻常的尺寸高了一些，是特意定制的吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: It's a few inches taller than most tables. Was it custom-made?

Desc.SourceString: 扶手处有一个圆滑的缺口，看起来并不是磨损或磕碰导致的。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a smooth notch on the armrest that doesn't look like it came from wear or a bump.

Desc.SourceString: 今天有治安官给我打电话，说某人违规开车上路，黑羽，你有什么头绪吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: A security officer called me about traffic violations. Blackbird, you know anything about that?

Desc.SourceString: 别想蒙混过关，那辆车我就没收了，从明天开始你给我重新学习交通安全守则。
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't try to fool me. I'm confiscating that car. Starting tomorrow, you'll be learning basic traffic rules.

Desc.SourceString: 每天两小时，不准偷懒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Two hours every day. No skipping.

Desc.SourceString: 忽然想到还有工作没做完……
Desc.LocalizedString: I suddenly remembered I've got things to do…
Ugh…

Desc.SourceString: 节选自噗卡乐园工作日志：本次茶点准备工作出现疏漏，导致章鱼先生临时改用茶杯充饥。对此造成的不便，我们深表歉意……咦我茶杯呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Excerpt from the Pukaland Work Log: Due to a minor catering oversight, Mr. Octopus was forced to snack on a teacup instead. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused… Wait. Where's my teacup?

Desc.SourceString: 温馨提示：如果感到自己还在旋转，甚至海特洛也开始旋转，请先确认是否已离开甜蜜大摆圈。
Desc.LocalizedString: Friendly reminder: If you still feel like you're spinning—or Hethereau itself starts spinning—please make sure you've actually stepped off the Punchulum Ride.

Desc.SourceString: 据体验者描述，这场「圆舞会」的地点比预计高了不少，疑似看见空中怪象。乐园方表示，以上仅为体验效果，如果在空中看到别的东西，记得：不要回答！不要回答！不要回答！
Desc.LocalizedString: Visitors report that this particular "waltz" took place much higher than expected, with several unusual sights spotted in the sky. Pukaland assures all guests that this is perfectly normal and absolutely part of the experience. If you see anything else up there, remember: Do not answer. Do not answer. Do not answer.

Desc.SourceString: （唔……等等我，我还没上车！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Ugh… wait for me! I haven't gotten on the bus yet!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多后悔了，塔吉多要上车！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo regrets it! Taygedo wants to get on the bus!)

Desc.SourceString: （鉴定师！鉴定师！慢一点！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Appraiser! Appraiser! Slow down!)

Desc.SourceString: （塔吉多害怕黑，鉴定师等等！）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Taygedo is scared of the dark! Appraiser, wait for me!)

Desc.SourceString: Tayge！Tayge！
Desc.LocalizedString: Tayge! Tayge!

Desc.SourceString: （鉴定师……塔吉多……还是和你一起走吧……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Appraiser… Taygedo should've gone with you after all…)

Desc.SourceString: 年轻人，你和魔女小姐是……什么关系呀？
Desc.LocalizedString: Young one, what is your relationship… with the witch lady?

Desc.SourceString: 只是朋友吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: Just friends, you say?

Desc.SourceString: 魔女小姐的住所很隐蔽，她和我说过，不会轻易告诉别人自己的具体地址。
Desc.LocalizedString: The witch lady lives somewhere hidden. She told me she didn't want anyone knowing where.

Desc.SourceString: 除非……是关系很好很好的人。
Desc.LocalizedString: Unless…it was someone close.

Desc.SourceString: 哈哈哈，七十多年前可不是这样的。那时候人们对异象和异能可不像现在这样包容。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hahaha, it wasn't like this seventy years ago. Back then, people weren't so tolerant of anomalies and Espers.

Desc.SourceString: 其实，魔女小姐也告诉过我地址。那阵子她搬家，特地写信给我。
Desc.LocalizedString: As a matter of fact, the witch lady told me her address before. At that time, she just moved and wrote a letter to tell me.

Desc.SourceString: 只是当时我迁居其他城市，又生了病，没法回海特洛拜访她。
Desc.LocalizedString: I just happened to be living in another city and was under the weather, so I didn't come back to Hethereau to see her.

Desc.SourceString: 结果现在稍微精神点，却找不到当年那封信，脑子也记不得地址了，唉……
Desc.LocalizedString: Now that I'm feeling better, I can't find the address she gave me, and I can't remember it from the top of my mind…

Desc.SourceString: 欸？我们是朋友。
Desc.LocalizedString: Huh? We're friends.

Desc.SourceString: 阿婆为什么这么问？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ma'am, why do you ask?

Desc.SourceString: 是这样吗？但是来魔女之家占卜的人还挺多的……
Desc.LocalizedString: Is that so? But plenty of people visit the Witch's House these days…

Desc.SourceString: （现在有第二杯半价活动吗？好像很划算。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Second cup at half price? Sounds like a good deal.)

Desc.SourceString: （不过我也喝不了两杯啊。今天要是有叫朋友一起来就好了……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (But I can't drink two cups myself. If only I had a friend here…)

Desc.SourceString: （那边的人是……曳尔沐？）
Desc.LocalizedString: (That's… Elyms over there?)

Desc.SourceString: （能让分隔两地的朋友相互联系的东西吗……曳尔沐挑选的藏身地点，真是很有她的风格。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Something that connects friends who are far apart…? How typical of Elyms.)

Desc.SourceString: （……看来曳尔沐不在这里。）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Looks like Elyms… isn't here.)

Desc.SourceString: （这里也不见曳尔沐……）
Desc.LocalizedString: (I don't see Elyms here either…)

Desc.SourceString: （电话声）
Desc.LocalizedString: (Phone rings)
